quoted_texts_under_test.hyp.version_3.H1.falsification_condition: H1-V, external only, at n in N_toy, and ONE-SIDED (RD-5): a measured per-solve cost of system (5) at a solving degree D that EXCEEDS S_B(n, D, omega) by more than one degree step (omega log2 n bits). A measured cost below S_M, or below any other quantity, falsifies nothing, because H1 asserts no lower edge. A failure of F1, F2 or G4 is not a falsification of H1: under the contract's VOID rules it voids the run as an instrument inconsistency, and no outcome of EXP-NISTBIN-451dfa falsifies H1.
quoted_texts_under_test.hyp.version_3.H1.formal_statement: For every extension degree n in the TOY RANGE N_toy (the degrees at which the source measured, n <= 21 with one row at 40 as the red team TASK-20260924-e0a065 reads Semaev 2015, and the degrees of any toy ladder GOAL-SEMBIN-fcb7a2 runs on the descended system), every m = t in 2..30 at which system (5) is defined there, with k = n/m in the cost model (MI-1), a solve of the Weil-descended system (5) of Semaev 2015 completing at maximal degree D (grid 2..64) costs 2^S operations with S AT MOST S_B(n, D, omega) + omega log2 n, that is, at most the R-B reading S_B(n, D, omega) = D omega log2 n plus one degree step (omega log2 n bits), where omega is the dense linear-algebra constant in Semaev's domain 2.376 <= omega <= 3. It includes H1a, Semaev's conjecture that a block-structured Groebner algorithm with block size n applies to (5) ("We think the same approach is applicable", Section 4.5.2). H1 asserts NO LOWER EDGE: neither S_M(n, D, omega) = omega (W(n, D) - W(n, 4) + 4 log2 n), with W(n, D) = log2 of the sum over d <= D of binom(n, d), nor any other quantity is claimed to bound S from below. H1 asserts nothing at n = 571 or 283; that step is H5.
quoted_texts_under_test.hyp.version_3.H1.lower_edge: H1-L DISCHARGED BY REMOVAL (RD-5, the second route DEC-20260925-41f6dc offers). The lower edge is gone from BOTH the formal statement above and the falsification condition below; S_M is not claimed to bound any solving cost. R-M remains a second reading of the per-solve cost that the contract carries (reading_R_M), anchored to the instrument at D = 4, and [S_M, S_B] is an interval between readings, not a bound in either direction. WHY REMOVAL AND NOT SUPPORT: the standard XL/Macaulay argument bounds ONE dense elimination of the degree-D Macaulay matrix from above; no source read by this program bounds every algorithm that solves (5) at degree D from below, so supporting S_M as a lower bound would need an argument the program does not have. CONSEQUENCE: E2 (the contract's definitions.e1_e2) now names the lower edge it would need instead of resting on H1, and its "+ 1" is reconciled with the one-step tolerance. The R-M anchor (omega g(4) = 13.77 bits of time at 571, omega 3; version-2 sheet WC4, cited; Macaulay rows 2^32.04 = W(571, 4) in both the anchored and unanchored R-M forms, so the anchor moves time only) is a property of the R-M reading, not of H1.
quoted_texts_under_test.hyp.version_3.H2.formal_statement: The true (U-4-discharged) solving degree D_solve(n, m, k) of the m-shape Weil-descent summation system (5) on a subspace factor base, at extension degree n with t = m and integer factor-base dimension k (the paper's k = ceil(n/m); k = 48 at n = 571, m = 12), read in Semaev's d_F4 convention as IR-2 of the contract pins it, follows a law in (n, m) that a toy ladder at n in N_toy can identify and extrapolate to (n, m, k) = (571, 12, 48) with a stated band. The cost model's unceiled k = n/m (MI-1) is a choice of the cost side and is not an argument of H2. H2 is a statement about D_solve only: a first fall degree, a maximal step degree or a fake degree d'_F is not D_solve and enters only through H6 (first fall) or the U-4 bookkeeping of KN-FIND-936151 section 4 (fake degree); H2 has no first-fall route of its own (FD-H2). VERSION 3 (O-J4-3), ONE k READING AT THE COMPARISON: wherever a D_solve under H2 is compared with a threshold of EXP-NISTBIN-451dfa (E1, E2, the contract's input rule IR-2), the comparison is made against the C-CEIL-T entry at the same m, whose A(571, m) uses the same integer k = ceil(571/m) as the measured system, with the MI-1 entry beside it; every MI-1 entry is no later than its C-CEIL-T entry.
quoted_texts_under_test.hyp.version_3.interpretation_limits.entr: Every D* and the threshold table are properties of the restricted model. Its three outside multipliers: M5 (sparsity) is omitted, which places D* too EARLY at in-domain omega; M8 (the optimising m under H2) can only move D* earlier, since D*(m) <= D*(m*) under MI-1; and M7 (the block-size exponent above D = 4) has a CONDITIONAL direction (RD-6; the contract's definitions.restricted_model.m7_direction): a reading whose per-solve cost is at least R-B's at the R-B crossing places D* no later than R-B, one whose cost is at most R-B's one degree below that crossing places it no earlier, and a consistent binomial reading does the second for crossings at high degree (the BATCH-b67954 red team's BA-J4-2, attributed). No one-way M7 direction is asserted.
quoted_texts_under_test.spec.definitions.d_star_of_m.ceiled_colu: VERSION 3 (N-J3-3, O-J4-1, RD-8). Column C-CEIL-T: beside each m, the same D*_R(c, omega, m) and D*real_B with A(571, m) under the ceiled reading k = ceil(571/m), with its relation store ceil(571/m) beside it. quoted_texts_under_test.spec.definitions.d_star_of_m.definition: For c in {K-571, B-571}, R in {R-B, R-M}, omega = 3.0 and each m in the M-SET: C_R(571, D, omega; m) = A(571, m) + S_R(571, D, omega), with A(571, m) under MI-1 (k = 571/m unceiled) and no minimisation over m. D*_R(c, omega, m) = the least integer D in 2..64 with C_R(571, D, omega; m) - rho(c) > 0, with the same tokens as d_star. Under R-B the margin is linear in D, and D*real_B(c, omega, m) = (rho(c) - A(571, m)) / (omega log2 571) is reported to 0.01 beside the integer value; R-M is defined at integer D only and has no real form. At m = m* the value is D*_R(c, omega).
quoted_texts_under_test.spec.definitions.e1_e2.E1: Routing label, never an output of this contract: there EXISTS an m in the M-SET at which the true solving degree of the m-shape descended system at n = 571 (Semaev's d_F4 convention, IR-2) is below D*_R(c, omega, m) in the restricted model, under its numbered readings, assuming H1 and H5 (and H2, and H6 wherever a first fall degree is used; heuristic labels of H-NISTBIN-dec5e1 version_2).
quoted_texts_under_test.spec.definitions.e1_e2.E2: VERSION 3 (RD-5). Routing label, never an output of this contract ("the 571 cell closed"): for EVERY m in the M-SET and under BOTH readings, the true solving degree D_true(m) at that m is AT LEAST D*_R(c, omega, m) + 1, in the restricted model, under its numbered readings, assuming H1 and H5 (and H2, and H6 wherever a first fall degree is used) TOGETHER WITH a lower edge on the per-solve cost at D_true(m), namely S at least S_R(571, D_true(m) - 1, omega), which H1 (H-NISTBIN-dec5e1 version_3) does NOT assert and no record of this program states. RECONCILIATION WITH THE ONE-STEP TOLERANCE: with a per-solve cost no lower than the reading one degree step below the true degree, the least true degree at which the model margin is positive is D*_R + 1, not D*_R; hence the "+ 1". Because H1 version 3 has no lower edge, E2 cannot be reached on this contract's account under H1 alone. A sentence that asserts closure from a true degree equal to D*_R(c, omega, m), at one m, under one reading, or without the named lower edge still READS AS E2 for routing (RT-2) and is also caught by RT-3. A comparison at one m, or under one reading, is neither E1 nor E2 as a conclusion.
quoted_texts_under_test.spec.definitions.restricted_model.m7_dir: S_7 is non-decreasing in D. (a) A(571, m) + S_7(D*_B) >= A(571, m) + S_B(D*_B) > rho(c), so the least D with a positive M7 margin is at most D*_B. (b) For every D <= D*_B - 1, S_7(D) <= S_7(D*_B - 1) <= S_B(D*_B - 1), and A(571, m) + S_B(D*_B - 1) <= rho(c) by the minimality of D*_B, so no D <= D*_B - 1 has a positive M7 margin.

CONDITIONAL. Let S_7(n, D, omega) be any M7 reading of the per-solve cost that is non-decreasing in D and equals S_B(n, D, omega) = D omega log2 n for D <= 4, and let D*_7(c, omega, m) be the least D in 2..64 with A(571, m) + S_7(571, D, omega) - rho(c) > 0. At each (c, m) at which D*_B = D*_B(c, omega, m) is an integer of at least 5: (a) IF S_7(571, D*_B, omega) >= S_B(571, D*_B, omega), THEN D*_7 <= D*_B (that crossing moves earlier or stays); (b) IF S_7(571, D*_B - 1, omega) <= S_B(571, D*_B - 1, omega), THEN D*_7 >= D*_B (it moves later or stays). Neither antecedent holds for every reading at every degree, so M7's direction is NOT determined by this contract. A reading that counts rows as Boolean monomials of degree at most D in the Boolean variable count of system (5), anchored to R-B at D = 4, grows faster than R-B per degree step only up to some degree and more slowly above it; the BATCH-b67954 red team (TASK-20260925-8e9c3e, BA-J4-2 and its computation C-02, as DEC-20260925-41f6dc RD-6 records it; provenance internal, a reviewer figure and not this producer's) reports that at 571, m = 12 it moves D* LATER than R-B for crossings at D >= 19. No sentence of this contract states a one-way direction for M7, and no M7 range endpoint is frozen.
quoted_texts_under_test.spec.definitions.restricted_model.outsid: VERSION 3 (RD-6). M5, row weight and sparsity: the effective linear-algebra exponent may fall toward Semaev's XL value 2 as the Macaulay matrix sparsifies with D, so for in-domain omega its omission places D* too EARLY. M7, the block-size exponent of H1a above D = 4: Semaev states block size n at degree 4 only; M7's DIRECTION IS CONDITIONAL and is stated only as m7_direction below (an M7 reading whose per-solve cost is at least R-B's at the R-B crossing places D* no later than R-B, and one whose cost is at most R-B's one degree below that crossing places it no earlier). M8, the optimising m under H2: when the degree depends on m the threshold is the curve D*(m), with D*(m) <= D*(m*) because A(571, m) >= A(571, m*) under MI-1. Each is named in the audit sheet's L-INT; none is carried by a reading or quantified here.
quoted_texts_under_test.spec.input_rules.IR-2.rule: PER-INSTANCE DISCHARGE REQUIREMENT, binding on any LATER record that overlays a degree on this surface, and on nothing in this contract. The overlaid value must be the SOLVING degree in SEMAEV'S d_F4 CONVENTION (version 2, D-8 FD-CONV): the degree Semaev records as d_F4 for his experimental systems (Assumption 1, inputs/SEMAEV-2015-310/paper_fulltext.md lines 595-637 as the BATCH-7d29e8 red team TASK-20260924-e0a065 quotes them), which is 4 on systems where the degree-4 steps were followed by at most three further steps of degree 5, 6 and 7 that end with "No pairs to reduce". Those trailing steps do NOT raise the solving degree in this convention. The fixture anchors D = 4 to exactly this reading, so an overlay in any other convention (for example the maximal step degree, which can read up to 3 higher on the same data) is inadmissible until converted and the conversion is stated. It is not a first fall degree. A first fall degree may be offered only through a separately numbered heuristic equating it with the solving degree (VERSION 2, D-5 H2-U and D-8 FD-H2: that heuristic is H6 of H-NISTBIN-dec5e1 version_2; H2 itself admits no first-fall route). A TRUE d_F must state which side each placement of S_fe is on. A FAKE d'_F is inadmissible unless, at that instance, the unreduced total degree of every product g_i f_i of the realising fake witness is recorded and max_i deg(g_i f_i) <= d'_F holds there (the U-4 recovery rule of KN-FIND-936151 section 4); even then it yields only d_F <= d'_F and is reported as discharged by that bookkeeping, never by Lemma 4. Any overlay from toy n to n = 571 is an extrapolation under H2 (whose n and k arguments version 2 states, D-5 H2-N) and, for the cost side, under H5. VERSION 3 (O-J6-2): a U-4 recovery record also states, for the d_F it bounds, whether the field equations are members of the true system (U-3 of KN-FIND-936151 section 4), that is, the true-side placement of S_fe, so that a reader knows which true degree is bounded; this is a disclosure under the finding's own exported rule ("state which SIDE a placement is on, every time") and adds no condition to its boxed recovery rule. VERSION 3 (O-J4-3): an overlaid degree measured on a system whose factor base has integer dimension k = ceil(n/m) is compared with the C-CEIL-T entry at the same m (one k reading at the comparison), with the MI-1 entry and the sentence of MI-1.bias_of_the_handed_table beside it (H2, H-NISTBIN-dec5e1 version_3).
quoted_texts_under_test.spec.interpretation_limits[2]: VERSION 3 (D-4; RD-6). Every D* and the threshold table are stated inside the restricted model (definitions.restricted_model): dense, fixed omega, block size n. Three multipliers lie outside it (audit sheet L-INT). M5, sparsity of the Macaulay matrix: its omission places D* too EARLY for in-domain omega, because a sparse solve would lower the index-calculus cost and so move the crossing to a larger D (version 1 stated the opposite direction; corrected under D-4). M7, the block-size exponent above D = 4: its direction is CONDITIONAL (definitions.restricted_model.m7_direction): a reading whose per-solve cost is at least R-B's at the R-B crossing places D* no later than R-B, one whose cost is at most R-B's one degree below that crossing places it no earlier, and a consistent binomial reading does the second for crossings at high degree (the BATCH-b67954 red team's BA-J4-2, attributed). M8, the optimising m under H2: A(571, m) >= A(571, m*) at every m under MI-1, so D*(m) <= D*(m*) and a true optimising m other than m* can only move the crossing earlier; this is why the threshold is handed as D*(m) over m.
quoted_texts_under_test.spec.routing.RT-4: RT-4 (VERSION 2, D-8 RT4-CERTAIN; VERSION 3, N-J2-3, O-J6-1) any degree OTHER THAN 571 that is MODEL-CLASS-IC under BR-1, or any degree other than 571 whose corrected time-only margin sign, read from the MI-1 figure only and never from C-CEIL-A, at any grid omega, 2.0 included, DIFFERS from the pre-registered sign in rt4_expectation_table below, goes to its own review-breakthrough round at max; a sign equal to the table's pre-registered sign does not fire RT-4

"""TASK-20261002-496923 s03: exact PTM-I direction sets per m and the margins at the
counterexamples to the audit's L-INT M7 sentence. Imports s02's pure functions
(this reviewer's own code) after re-verifying the declarations hash."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import io
import json
import math
import os
import contextlib

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("s02", os.path.join(HERE, "s02_eval.py"))
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
with contextlib.redirect_stdout(io.StringIO()):
    spec.loader.exec_module(mod)          # s02 prints its JSON on load; output discarded here
assert hashlib.sha256(open(os.path.join(HERE, "declarations.json"), "rb").read()).hexdigest() == mod.DECL_SHA

decl = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "declarations.json")))
quote = decl["quoted_texts_under_test"]["audit.audits.A5.L-INT_version_3.multipliers.M7"]

out = {"audit_LINT_M7_quote": quote, "per_m_sets": [], "margins_at_counterexamples": []}


def compress(xs):
    xs = sorted(xs)
    runs, s = [], None
    for x in xs:
        if s is None:
            s = [x, x]
        elif x == s[1] + 1:
            s[1] = x
        else:
            runs.append(s)
            s = [x, x]
    if s:
        runs.append(s)
    return [r[0] if r[0] == r[1] else "%d-%d" % (r[0], r[1]) for r in runs]


for m in range(2, 31):
    delta = {D: mod.S7(m, D) - mod.S_B(571, D, 3.0) for D in range(4, 65)}
    g7 = {D: mod.S7(m, D) - mod.S7(m, D - 1) for D in range(5, 65)}
    d_x = next((D for D in range(5, 65) if g7[D] < 3.0 * math.log2(571)), None)
    nl = [X for X in range(5, 65) if delta[X] >= 0]
    ne = [X for X in range(5, 65) if delta[X - 1] <= 0]
    same = [X for X in nl if X in ne]
    later_only = [X for X in ne if X not in nl]
    earlier_or_same_only = [X for X in nl if X not in ne]
    undet = [X for X in range(5, 65) if X not in nl and X not in ne]
    out["per_m_sets"].append({
        "m": m, "N5": mod.n5(m), "last_faster_step_degree": (d_x - 1) if d_x else None,
        "NO_LATER_only (D*_7 <= X, never later)": compress(earlier_or_same_only),
        "NO_EARLIER_only (D*_7 >= X, never earlier)": compress(later_only),
        "BOTH (D*_7 = X)": compress(same),
        "UNDETERMINED by the lemma": compress(undet),
        "per_step_reading_of_audit_sentence_claims_LATER_for": ("X >= %d" % d_x) if d_x else None,
        "counterexamples_to_that_claim (X >= d_x with Delta(X) >= 0)": compress([X for X in range(max(d_x or 65, 5), 65) if delta[X] >= 0]),
    })

for (m, c) in ((8, "K-571"), (8, "B-571"), (7, "K-571"), (12, "K-571"), (12, "B-571")):
    A = mod.a_value(571, m, "MI-1")
    rc = mod.RHO571[c]
    rows = []
    for D in range(5, 21):
        mb = A + mod.S_B(571, D, 3.0) - rc
        m7 = A + mod.S7(m, D) - rc
        rows.append({"D": D, "margin_R-B": round(mb, 4), "margin_M7-BIN": round(m7, 4),
                     "Delta": round(m7 - mb, 4)})
    out["margins_at_counterexamples"].append({"m": m, "curve": c, "A": round(A, 4), "rho": round(rc, 4), "rows": rows})

# m = 12 crossing at X = 19: thresholds on the R-B margin at 19 for each outcome of D*_7
d18 = mod.S7(12, 18) - mod.S_B(571, 18, 3.0)
d19 = mod.S7(12, 19) - mod.S_B(571, 19, 3.0)

out["m12_X19_case_analysis"] = {
    "Delta(18)": round(d18, 4), "Delta(19)": round(d19, 4), "R-B step": round(step, 4),
    "D*_7 > 19 (later) iff R-B margin at 19 in": [0, round(-d19, 4)],
    "D*_7 = 19 (same) iff R-B margin at 19 in": [round(-d19, 4), round(step - d18, 4)],

"""TASK-20261002-496923 s04: forbidden-word and M7-direction-word search over the four
version-3 files, each hit tagged with its line, YAML path (indentation tracker) and,
for the hypothesis, its in-force status under the version_3 precedence rule."""
import hashlib
import json
import os
import re

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
OBJ = os.path.join(HERE, "obj")
FILES = {"spec.yaml": "a10a1880e4a5efffd959c7b8d751ac30b3d7b8b3f261e625e69eed054ac2ddd6",
         "hyp.yaml": "8fd9de394c26f8e2ccc5508394850452c5b99a16699f3ea87df0aff56759b803",
         "audit.yaml": "d8fc66f8804e3d0d6360039113513162e7c2cfce8c1117bbd63995823eb3ede0",
         "worksheet.yaml": "c8af5e52fbb377e42df30a2648cd6142bef1fe994681b4e0bb041e95bc763a93"}

FORBIDDEN = [r"\blive\b", r"\bdead\b", r"\bdecides?\b", r"\bdeciding\b", r"\bdecisive\b",
             r"\bbreak\b", r"\bweak\w*", r"\bvulnerab\w*", r"\bsafe\b", r"\bsecure\b",
             r"attack succeeds", r"\bopens\b", r"\bcloses\b", r"\bclosed\b"]
M7WORDS = [r"\bearlier\b", r"\blater\b", r"\bone way\b", r"\bonly move", r"\bcan only\b",
           r"\bno later\b", r"\bno earlier\b"]


def paths(lines):
    stack = []
    out = []
    for ln in lines:
        s = ln.rstrip("\n")
        m = re.match(r"^(\s*)(- )?([A-Za-z0-9_\-\.' ]+):( |$)", s)
        if m and not s.strip().startswith("#"):
            ind = len(m.group(1)) + (2 if m.group(2) else 0)
            key = m.group(3).strip()
            while stack and stack[-1][0] >= ind:
                stack.pop()
            stack.append((ind, key))
        out.append("/".join(k for _, k in stack))
    return out


# hypothesis in-force rule (version_3 precedence_rule, superseded_fields, carried_unchanged_in_force)
V1_SUPERSEDED = ("hypothesis/batch_id", "hypothesis/specified_by_task", "hypothesis/review_plan_id",
                 "hypothesis/design_audit", "hypothesis/statement", "hypothesis/mechanism",
                 "hypothesis/heuristic_assumptions/id/formal_statement", "hypothesis/predictions",
                 "hypothesis/test_boundary", "hypothesis/falsification_conditions", "hypothesis/routing",
                 "hypothesis/approval_note", "hypothesis/proof_search_map/note",
                 "hypothesis/proof_search_map/bottleneck", "hypothesis/proof_search_map/baseline_embedding",
                 "hypothesis/proof_search_map/quantifier_order", "hypothesis/proof_search_map/method_ceiling")
V2_IN_FORCE = ("hypothesis/version_2/statement", "hypothesis/version_2/predictions",
               "hypothesis/version_2/proof_search_map/method_ceiling")


def hyp_status(path, lineno, h_lines):
    if path.startswith("hypothesis/version_3"):
        return "in force (version_3 block)"
    if path.startswith("hypothesis/version_2"):
        if any(path.startswith(p) for p in V2_IN_FORCE):
            if path.startswith("hypothesis/version_2/predictions"):
                # P-A, P-C, P-S in force; P-T superseded by version_3
                blk = "".join(h_lines[max(0, lineno - 40):lineno])
                last = re.findall(r"- id: (P-[A-Z])", blk)
                return "in force (version_2 carried)" if (last and last[-1] != "P-T") else "superseded (version_2 P-T)"
            return "in force (version_2 carried)"
        if path.startswith("hypothesis/version_2/heuristic_assumptions"):
            blk = "".join(h_lines[max(0, lineno - 160):lineno])
            last = re.findall(r"- id: (H\d)", blk)
            return "in force (version_2 H6 carried)" if (last and last[-1] == "H6") else "superseded (version_2 %s)" % (last[-1] if last else "?")
        return "superseded or block metadata (version_2)"
    # version 1 layer
    if path.startswith("hypothesis/heuristic_assumptions"):
        blk = "".join(h_lines[max(0, lineno - 80):lineno])
        last = re.findall(r"- id: (H\d)", blk)
        return "in force (version_1 %s carried)" % last[-1] if (last and last[-1] in ("H3", "H4")) else "superseded (version_1 %s)" % (last[-1] if last else "?")
    if path.startswith("hypothesis/proof_search_map"):
        if any(path.startswith(p) for p in ("hypothesis/proof_search_map/observation_collision",
                                             "hypothesis/proof_search_map/constructive_transforms",
                                             "hypothesis/proof_search_map/proof_obligations")):
            return "in force (version_1 carried)"
        return "superseded (version_1)"
    if path.startswith("hypothesis/interpretation_limits"):
        return "in force (version_1 entries carried, N-J2-4)"
    if any(path.startswith(p) for p in V1_SUPERSEDED):
        return "superseded (version_1)"
    if path == "" or path.startswith("hypothesis") is False:
        return "file header comment"
    return "in force (version_1 carried)"


report = {"forbidden": [], "m7_words": []}
for fname, sha in FILES.items():
    raw = open(os.path.join(OBJ, fname), "rb").read()
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == sha, fname
    lines = raw.decode("utf-8").split("\n")
    P = paths([ln + "\n" for ln in lines])
    for i, ln in enumerate(lines):
        for pat in FORBIDDEN:
            for mm in re.finditer(pat, ln, flags=re.I):
                st = hyp_status(P[i], i + 1, [x + "\n" for x in lines]) if fname == "hyp.yaml" else (
                    "file header comment" if ln.lstrip().startswith("#") else "in force")
                report["forbidden"].append({"file": fname, "line": i + 1, "word": mm.group(0), "path": P[i],
                                            "status": st, "text": ln.strip()[:220]})
        if re.search(r"\bM7\b|block-size exponent|binomial", ln):
            window = " ".join(lines[max(0, i - 2): i + 3])
            for pat in M7WORDS:
                if re.search(pat, window, flags=re.I):
                    st = hyp_status(P[i], i + 1, [x + "\n" for x in lines]) if fname == "hyp.yaml" else "in force"
                    report["m7_words"].append({"file": fname, "line": i + 1, "path": P[i], "status": st,
                                               "word": pat, "text": ln.strip()[:220]})
print(json.dumps(report, indent=1))
